title: Just-infinite Jordan Banach algebras
summary: By analogy with the well-established notions of just-infinite groups and just-infinite algebras, in particular $C^*$-algebras, we initiate a study of just-infinite $JB$-algebras, i.e. infinite dimensional $JB$-algebras for which all proper quotients are finite dimensional. We investigate the connections between a just-infinite $C^*$-algebra $A$ and its Jordan algebra $H(A,*)$ of self-adjoint elements. We also show that any just-infinite $JB$-algebra $J$ either is a infinite-dimensional spin factor or there exists a $C^*$-algebra $A$ and just-infinite norm-closed real $*$-subalgebras $A_1$…
